club.name: Club
club.description: Heavy and crude, but it is a weapon.

bridge.text: Your sword at your hip, you start across the old rope bridge. Skill {skill}.

river.text: Halfway across, a plank snaps. You grab the rope and save yourself, but your sword spins down into the river. With no weapon you fight at -4 Skill: yours is now {skill}.

choices.text: Search the bank for something to fight with

bank.text: Among the reeds lies a heavy club, washed up by some flood. It is no sword, but you are armed again: Skill {skill}.

bandit.text: A bandit steps out onto the road, knife drawn. "Your purse," she says.

won.text: The bandit runs into the trees. The road ahead is clear.
